a260903p1.summary: The district has blocked generative AI tools on student devices as officials review the role of AI in classrooms
a260903p1.title: The LA Unified School District bars ~378,000 students from using AI tools on district-provided laptops and tablets as officials review AI's role in classrooms (Julia Szymanski/LAmag)

a260903p10.summary: The company also announced a new Eufy video doorbell with VR features and a window camera.
a260903p10.title: Anker unveils the Eufy MindBase, a local AI hub for its cameras that runs an on-device, Anker-developed LLM, with a dedicated AI chip and up to 48TB of storage (Jennifer Pattison Tuohy/The Verge)

a260903p11.summary: Parents are using AI to organise their families, from managing busy schedules to researching preschools, planning meals and grocery shopping.
a260903p11.title: How some parents, mostly mothers, use AI to help them organize their families' schedules and automate mundane household tasks via apps like Ollie and Cozi Max (Valeriya Safronova/Financial Times)

a260903p12.summary: After finding antitrust violations, federal courts have been reluctant to impose harsh sanctions. They fear meddling in markets where technology is racing ahead.
a260903p12.title: US federal courts have consistently shown a wariness in demanding structural remedies against Big Tech despite finding antitrust liability, as tech races ahead (Steve Lohr/New York Times)

a260903p13.summary: We really, really need to talk about venture capital. Because it's not “venture capital” anymore.
a260903p13.title: Modern venture capital has transformed into an unchecked oligarchy, or "Cancer Capital", where mega-firms managing $50B+ live off fees and shift risk elsewhere (Anil Dash)

a260903p14.summary: In addition, the F.C.C. is weighing stiff restrictions on common drone technology such as thermal imaging and aerosol spraying.
a260903p14.title: The Trump administration imposes tariffs of up to 100% on foreign drones, including 100% on models over 55lbs or with thermal imaging, in a bid to thwart China (Farah Stockman/New York Times)

a260903p15.summary: Israeli cybersecurity startup Guardio raised funds from investors including Assaf Rappaport, the founder of cloud security firm Wiz …
a260903p15.title: Tel Aviv-based Guardio, which offers a subscription-based consumer security service that protects digital accounts like emails, raised $40M at a $1.1B valuation (Marissa Newman/Bloomberg)

a260903p16.summary: A little-known company called Fluidstack has become a test bed for Google's plans to sell its own AI chip.
a260903p16.title: Sources: neocloud Fluidstack closed a $1.5B round led by Jane Street at an $18B+ valuation; in July, the startup announced a $750M round at a $7.5B valuation (Iain Martin/Forbes)

a260903p17.summary: PlusAI has agreed to go public through a merger with blank-check firm Texas Ventures Acquisition III Corp (TVA.O) …
a260903p17.title: PlusAI, which is operating autonomous freight routes in Texas with trucking company Ryder, plans to go public in a SPAC deal at an ~$800M pre-money equity value (Pragyan Kalita/Reuters)

a260903p18.summary: Nvidia has officially agreed to buy open-source artificial intelligence platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion …
a260903p18.title: Nvidia agrees to acquire Hugging Face for $12.9B, its second-biggest acquisition yet, after it paid $20B to buy assets from chipmaker Groq in December 2025 (Ari Levy/CNBC)

a260903p19.summary: A new market intelligence report suggests that Apple will be paying four times more for iPhone 18 Pro memory than it did for last year's model.
a260903p19.title: TrendForce: for a 256GB iPhone Pro model, Q3 memory costs are forecast to be up nearly 400% YoY; Apple is not expected to pass on the full increase to customers (Ben Lovejoy/9to5Mac)

a260903p2.summary: Long before the era of the hyperscalers and neoclouds, and decades ahead of the AI data center boom, there was Equinix.
a260903p2.title: Equinix, whose stock is up 33% YTD, pushing its market cap to $100B, inks a deal with Nvidia to let customers run their AI models on the Together AI platform (CNBC)

a260903p20.summary: HTC Corp. is rolling out its Vive Eagle smart glasses in the US, entering a market where category leader Meta Platforms Inc …
a260903p20.title: HTC rolls out its $499 Vive Eagle smart glasses, which let users choose between Gemini or ChatGPT as their assistant, in North America, Europe, and Australia (Chris Welch/Bloomberg)

a260903p21.summary: When a company that builds fire trucks, rail-maintenance machinery, or electric vehicle chargers is invited to bid on a big contract …
a260903p21.title: Munich-based Atira, which aims to use AI to automate the parsing and generation of complex bid proposals, raised a $15M seed led by Accel and a $2.5M pre-seed (Jeremy Kahn/Fortune)

a260903p22.summary: Artificial intelligence firm Humain is planning to raise an initial $2.5 billion from global and domestic investors for a fund to invest …
a260903p22.title: Sources: Riyadh-based AI startup Humain is planning to raise an initial $2.5B fund to help finance data center capacity of 250 MW in Saudi Arabia (Omar El Chmouri/Bloomberg)

a260903p23.summary: As the artificial intelligence companies Anthropic and OpenAI prepare to go public, the question around Silicon Valley is which investors will win big.
a260903p23.title: PitchBook: 95+ investors put money into both Anthropic and OpenAI amid shifting norms; sources: Menlo, Lightspeed, and Iconiq each hold 1%-2% Anthropic stakes (Erin Griffith/New York Times)

a260903p24.summary: The Israeli cloud security company was valued at $1.5 billion when it raised $250 million in January, and has since attracted fresh backing …
a260903p24.title: Upwind, which filters false security alerts in cloud apps so companies can focus on actual risks, raised ~$300M at a ~$3.8B valuation, up from ~$1.5B in January (Meir Orbach/CTech)

a260903p25.summary: A widespread outage has taken out popular AI platforms including ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok. — With a spike in reports on DownDetector …
a260903p25.title: Claude, ChatGPT, and Grok are experiencing issues; Anthropic reports errors across Opus 4.8 and Opus 5, and OpenAI reports errors across ChatGPT and Codex (Ben Schoon/9to5Google)

a260903p26.summary: Nvidia is finally getting more specific about the launch of the RTX Spark. The chip, which it is now officially calling the …
a260903p26.title: Nvidia says the RTX Spark N1X launches in October in two configurations: a 20-core CPU with a 6,144-core Blackwell GPU and an 18-core CPU with a 5,120-core GPU (Andrew E. Freedman/Tom's Hardware)

a260903p29.summary: Ultrahuman, an Indian startup best known for making smart rings, has raised $70 million in a new funding round that includes backing …
a260903p29.title: India-based smart ring maker Ultrahuman raised $70M, including $5M in debt, a source says at a $365M valuation, and is working with Qualcomm on a new ring (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)

a260903p3.summary: More than half of abuse occurred on mainstream social media platforms; less than 1 per cent of all experiences were reported to authorities, new report finds
a260903p3.title: A survey of 21,000 internet-using children aged 12 to 17 across 21 countries finds almost one in five experienced tech-facilitated sexual exploitation and abuse (UNICEF)

a260903p30.summary: Microsoft is trying once again to tempt people without an Xbox into its ecosystem. … Microsoft says it will let anyone access Xbox Cloud Gaming …
a260903p30.title: Microsoft will open Xbox Cloud Gaming to non-Game Pass users via a pay-as-you-go model; Ultimate subs will be limited to 15 hours per month of cloud gaming (Tom Warren/The Verge)

a260903p31.summary: Saudi Arabia's artificial intelligence company Humain has built a national AI platform based on an open model from Chinese lab MiniMax Group Inc. …
a260903p31.title: Humain launches humain-m3, an Arabic-language model developed with MiniMax, amid controversy among US allies over sovereign AI built with Chinese models (Bloomberg)

a260903p32.summary: Thinking Machines Lab, the AI developer led by ex-OpenAI chief technology officer Mira Murati, is in talks to raise at least $1 billion …
a260903p32.title: Sources: Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab is in talks to raise $1B+ at a $40B+ pre-money valuation, lower than the $50B+ valuation it sought last year (The Information)

a260903p33.summary: OpenAI's next big model is here: GPT-6 Astra. The company calls it a “generational leap in capability” …
a260903p33.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra, initially for customers in its Daybreak program; Greg Brockman says it is a "generational leap" and "we are now in the AGI era" (Hayden Field/The Verge)

a260903p34.summary: OpenAI's now infamous model that was part of the Hugging Face breach is about to be loose in the world, but with new safeguards.
a260903p34.title: OpenAI prices GPT-6 Astra at $10/1M input tokens and $50/1M output tokens, matching Anthropic's pricing for Claude Fable 5.1 (The Deep View)

a260903p35.summary: OpenAI leaders think the company's next generation model, which excels at computer use and coding, may mark a major milestone in AI development.
a260903p35.title: OpenAI calls GPT-6 Astra the "world's best computer use model"; in tests, it booked DMV appointments and searched job listings faster than the average person (Maxwell Zeff/Wired)

a260903p36.summary: OpenAI on Thursday released GPT-6 Astra, which president Greg Brockman called a “generational leap” and said could eventually be seen as the arrival of artificial general intelligence, or AGI.
a260903p36.title: OpenAI says Astra was built on its largest-ever training run, using more than 100,000 GPUs at its Stargate site in Texas (Ina Fried/Axios)

a260903p37.summary: Then it priced the thing at 10 cents per hour of audio. — That figure deserves a pause. … Thursday's early-bird price cuts that by roughly 72%.
a260903p37.title: Microsoft AI debuts MAI-Transcribe-2, a speech recognition model that it says beats Gemini 3.5 Transcribe and GPT-Transcribe, at $0.10/audio hour through 2026 (Michael Nuñez/VentureBeat)

a260903p38.summary: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg expressed concerns about plans for a national AI regulator in a previously unreported phone call …
a260903p38.title: A White House official says Zuckerberg opposed a US AI regulator in a call with Trump last month; another source says he didn't ask Trump to change his stance (Politico)

a260903p39.summary: US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said Anthropic PBC has resolved its long-running issues with the Trump administration but a top Pentagon official begs to differ.
a260903p39.title: DOD's Emil Michael says Anthropic is still a designated supply chain risk, a day after Howard Lutnick said it resolved its issues with the Trump administration (Maggie Eastland/Bloomberg)

a260903p4.summary: Ride-hailing app admits its effort to back workers may appear ‘ironic’ after years of clashes with drivers.
a260903p4.title: Uber is aligning with drivers' unions in a bid to slow the rollout of robotaxis across the US, as it faces a technological disruption to its core business (Rafe Rosner-Uddin/Financial Times)

a260903p40.summary: Summary — GPT-6 Astra scores 62.7% for $26K on ARC-AGI-3 Semi-Private with our Standard harness, and 99.9% for $19K with a Provider Adapter harness.
a260903p40.title: GPT-6 Astra scores 62.7% on ARC-AGI-3 with the standard harness and 99.9% with a new provider adapter harness; Claude Opus 5 scored 30.2%, and GPT-5.6 Sol 7.8% (Greg Kamradt/ARC Prize)

a260903p41.summary: Crusoe, a data center upstart with contracts to supply AI computing power to the likes of Meta Platforms Inc. and Oracle Corp. …
a260903p41.title: Sources: Crusoe signed a ~$13B, five-year deal with Jane Street to provide GPUs and other infrastructure for AI training and inference via its cloud platform (Bloomberg)

a260903p42.summary: The $1 billion will come in the form of expanded subsidized access to models, training, technical support and partnerships for participating organizations.
a260903p42.title: OpenAI commits $1B in subsidized model access, training, support, and partnerships to a new initiative aimed at protecting essential services around the world (Sam Sabin/Axios)

a260903p43.summary: Adobe on Thursday named Anil Chakravarthy as its next CEO, succeeding Shantanu Narayen, who announced he would step down earlier this year.
a260903p43.title: Adobe names Customer Experience Orchestration president Anil Chakravarthy as CEO, effective December 1, replacing Shantanu Narayen, who becomes executive chair (Annie Palmer/CNBC)

a260903p5.summary: Previously unpublished government data reveals the scale of Taiwan's crackdown on Chinese companies accused of hiding their ties …
a260903p5.title: Taiwan investigated 166 cases in six years involving companies allegedly hiding China ties while pursuing chip talent and tech, alongside 67 trade-secret probes (Kinling Lo/Rest of World)

a260903p6.summary: Desire for differentiation drives push to build in-house platforms — After a few short years of learning, experimenting and planning …
a260903p6.title: Several international law firms are seeking to build bespoke AI tools to gain an edge and protect their IP, while using off-the-shelf AI for everyday tasks (Nick Huber/Financial Times)

a260903p7.summary: Organized opposition toppled a $100 billion project from developers backed by two of the world's biggest private equity companies.
a260903p7.title: How organized opposition that toppled a $100B data center project in Virginia's Prince William County became a blueprint for data center backlash in the US (Dawn Lim/Bloomberg)

a260903p8.summary: Company bosses, officials say advances in technology are already making AI safer than under government regulations
a260903p8.title: At the G20 summit, Jensen Huang, Mark Zuckerberg, Sam Altman, and Elon Musk joined Trump officials in lobbying policymakers against heavy AI regulations (Amrith Ramkumar/Wall Street Journal)

a260903p9.summary: Representatives from the world's largest economies unanimously agreed to adopt guidelines proposed by the US that call …
a260903p9.title: All G20 nations unanimously endorse the non-binding Carolina Principles, a US-proposed framework advocating for a lighter-touch, sector-specific AI regulation (Maggie Eastland/Bloomberg)
